translation: Dugukolo minnu na yɔrɔ in na, walasa ka taa a yɛrɛ ma, nka dɔlɔ min nu na sɔrɔ sira fila la. Yaw lɛrɛ. An ka Yaw baara kɛ cogo di? An bɛ baro Kuma kɔnɔ. A bɛ fɔ ale de na Alekisanndrɛ mɔgɔw fɛ: o de kɔrɔ ye! Ko Kelen de bɛ yen, ko kelen dɔrɔn de bɛ yen. Nin yɔrɔ min na an yɛn ko Kuma bɛ baro kɛ, o bɛ ma, kuma bɛ yen, kelen-kelen bɛ yen. An bɛ baro kɛ min na? Baro kɛ min kɔnɔ, kuma kelen bɛ yen. Nin baro in bɛɛ kɔnɔ, Yaw bɛ baro kɛ, a bɛ kuma, a fɔlɔ len na, ale de bɛ baro bila. Ko: «Nin ye kuma ye.» Kuma kɔkanna dɔw bɛ yen. O kuma kɔkanna ni dɔgɔya, o ye dɔgɔya baro ye. Yaw ye dɔgɔya baro kɛ, a b'a fɔ: «Kuma bɛ dɔgɔya kosɛbɛ.» O de ye tiɲɛ ye. Tiɲɛ ninnu bɛɛ bɛ yen, u ka baro bɛ yen. Baro kɔkanna dɔw bɛ yen. Nin baro in bɛɛ kɔnɔ, Yaw bɛ baro kɛ, a bɛ kuma. A bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma. Yaw, a bɛ kuma fɛn caman na. A bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma. Nin ye baro ye min ka kelen ye. Kuma kelen-kelen bɛ yen. An bɛ baro kɛ, an bɛ kuma, an bɛ baro bila. Yaw ye baro bila, a bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma. Nin baro in bɛɛ kɔnɔ, Yaw bɛ baro kɛ, a bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma. O de ye tiɲɛ ye. Tiɲɛ ninnu bɛɛ bɛ yen. Baro kɔkanna dɔw bɛ yen. Nin baro in bɛɛ kɔnɔ, Yaw bɛ baro kɛ, a bɛ kuma. A bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma, a bɛ kuma.
